clips.title: 万斯：与伊朗对话取得重大进展 霍尔木兹海峡保持开放
title_lines: 万斯：与伊朗对话取得重大进展
霍尔木兹海峡保持开放
伊朗同意IAEA核查人员重返

subtitles.en: Look, yesterday was a very, very good day. We made a lot of good progress.
subtitles.zh: 昨天是非常非常好的一天，我们取得了很大进展。

subtitles.en: We did exactly what we wanted to do, which is accomplish four things for the American people.
subtitles.zh: 我们完全实现了目标，为美国人民完成了四件事。
en_highlights: exactly what we wanted to do

subtitles.en: First, we wanted to build a mechanism for keeping the Strait of Hormuz open.
subtitles.zh: 首先，我们建立了保持霍尔木兹海峡开放的机制。
en_highlights: keeping the Strait of Hormuz open

subtitles.en: It is open. We've seen, of course, gas prices and oil prices come down.
subtitles.zh: 海峡是开放的，我们看到油气价格已经下降。
en_highlights: gas prices and oil prices come down

subtitles.en: Millions and millions of barrels of crude and natural gas flowing through the Strait of Hormuz that weren't flowing before.
subtitles.zh: 数百万桶原油和天然气正通过霍尔木兹海峡，这是以前没有的。
zh_highlights: 数百万桶原油和天然气
en_highlights: flowing through the Strait of Hormuz

subtitles.en: But we also wanted to make sure that we actually set up the coordination mechanism so that we could demine the Strait of Hormuz so that when there are the conflicts that inevitably come up,
subtitles.zh: 我们还建立了协调机制，以便在霍尔木兹海峡排雷，应对不可避免的冲突。

subtitles.en: we can make sure we work through them rather than that leading to escalation and that is exactly what we did yesterday.
subtitles.zh: 确保我们能化解冲突，而不是升级，这正是昨天做到的。

subtitles.en: Number two, we also wanted to build a mechanism, a similar mechanism for deconfliction for the regional ceasefire.
subtitles.zh: 第二，我们建立了类似的机制，用于区域停火的冲突降级。

subtitles.en: As the President of the United States has himself said, sometimes these ceasefires just mean you're shooting a little bit less.
subtitles.zh: 正如美国总统所说，有时停火只是意味着射击少了一点。

subtitles.en: But we wanted to make sure that we had the proper coordination set up so that if there is shooting, if Hezbollah fires at Israel or if Israel responds,
subtitles.zh: 但我们希望确保有适当的协调，以便在发生射击时，比如真主党向以色列开火或以色列反击。

subtitles.en: if there are other conflicts that arise in the region, we're actually talking to each other and figuring out how to stop the shooting, how to make the region safer,
subtitles.zh: 如果地区内出现其他冲突，我们实际上在互相沟通，想办法停止交火，让地区更安全，

subtitles.en: our allies, and everybody else. We set that up as well.
subtitles.zh: 我们的盟友和其他各方。我们也建立了这样的机制。

subtitles.en: Number three, we, and this is probably what we're most excited about as Americans, the Iranians have agreed to invite IAEA inspectors
subtitles.zh: 第三，我们——这可能是我们美国人最兴奋的一点——伊朗已同意邀请国际原子能机构核查人员
zh_highlights: 国际原子能机构核查人员
